@@U03432@@
vanish with the first cock’s crow. Here one day, gone the next.

@@U03434@@
I honor you, venerable head crowned with dense and lofty oaks, that not even the moon’s bright glow can pierce to its midnight depths! But what’s that faint light I see, there, in the bushes? Amazing how things work out! Its 荷蒙库鲁斯, to be sure! Where have you been, little friend?

@@U03436@@
Floating around from place to place. Oh, I want so to find the finest way of becoming, and finally shatter in pieces this glass. But what I’ve seen so far isn't something I'd like to become a part of. Promise not to tell, but I’m on the trail of two philosophers. I listened in on them, and they never stopped talking about Nature: “Nature, Nature!” I'll want to stick close to them, for sure. I think they must know the way of living things, and can show me finally the wisest course to follow.

@@U03438@@
No, do it yourself, forge your own path. Where phantoms are, there are philosophers; and in the bargain, to ingratiate themselves, they'll invent a dozen phantoms of their own. Make no mistakes and you'll never find wisdom!
translation:
@@U03432@@
随着第一声公鸡的啼鸣而消失。一天在这里，第二天就消失了。

@@U03434@@
我向您致以崇高的敬意，可敬的头顶上戴着茂密而高大的橡树，即使是月亮的明亮光芒也无法穿透午夜的深处！但我在灌木丛中看到的那微弱的光是什么？事情的进展令人惊奇！毫无疑问，它是荷蒙库鲁斯！小朋友你去哪儿了？

@@U03436@@
从一个地方漂到另一个地方。噢，我要找到最好的成为方式，最后将这块玻璃打碎。但到目前为止我所看到的并不是我想成为其中的一部分。保证不说出去，但我正在追踪两位哲学家。我听他们说话，他们不停地谈论自然：“自然，自然！”我肯定会想靠近他们。我想他们一定知道生物的生存之道，并且能够最终向我展示最明智的做法。

@@U03438@@
不，自己做，开辟自己的路。哪里有幽灵，哪里就有哲学家；哪里有幽灵，哪里就有哲学家。为了讨好自己，他们会发明一打自己的幻影。不犯错误，你永远找不到智慧！
